manage_gateway_admin_url_missing: The gateway admin address comes from the deployment configuration. This deployment has none configured.
manage_gateway_collection_not_found: Collection {name} does not exist (removed, or the name is wrong).
manage_gateway_panorama_blurb: Model gateway routes and provider credentials.
manage_gateway_placement_empty: This collection has no profile sets yet.
manage_gateway_remove_collection_body: Remove the collection {name}? Its {sets} profile sets and {profiles} profiles go with it. Provider credentials stay.
manage_gateway_remove_group_body: Delete the group {name}? Its memberships and the publications pointing at it are removed with it.
manage_gateway_remove_provider_body: Delete the provider {name} from the pool? Profiles still pointing at it must be re-pointed first.
manage_gateway_remove_set_body:
Delete the profile set {name} from the platform catalog? This cannot be undone.
The profiles stay in the catalog.
manage_gateway_remove_unassigned_body: Delete the unassigned profile {name} from {collection}? The provider credential is removed only if no other profile uses it.
manage_gateway_set_desc: A profile set lists model profiles in failover order.
manage_gateway_set_member_shared: This profile is also in {sets}; editing it changes those too.
manage_gateway_set_members_order_hint: Top to bottom is the failover order: a request goes to the first member that can take it.
manage_gateway_set_save_partial: Saved {saved} of {total} member edits; the description, or which members the set holds and in what order, did not save.
manage_gateway_subtitle: Platform catalog · distinct from each tagma's local configuration
manage_gateway_unassigned_desc: Unassigned profiles sit outside every profile set. Drag one into a set to add it to the catalog.
manage_gateway_unassigned_desc_collectio: Unassigned profiles in {collection} sit outside every profile set. Drag one onto a set here to add it.
